principle: If ANY path blocks, flow reroutes through the circle

anterior_cerebral.carries: Git push/pull, model sync, Forgejo mirror
anterior_cerebral.redundant: northGate can also pull from GitHub directly

middle_cerebral.redundant: sporeGate also reaches data via HTTP :8080

posterior_cerebral.redundant: ironGate can pull from Forgejo independently

internal_carotid_R.carries: NOT YET USED — available for direct northGate or sporeGate link
internal_carotid_R.redundant: Could bypass MikroTik entirely for critical path

vertebral_L.redundant: Pixel on LAN 1 WiFi when in House 1

basilar.carries: External access, RSS, Tor hidden service

communicating_posterior.carries: Kevin's remote access from any gate to any gate
communicating_posterior.redundant: SSH as fallback for all gates

phase_1_immediate.move_ATT: Move ATT modem to other side of brick wall (near WAN fiber ingress)
phase_1_immediate.rationale: Shorter fiber run, cleaner cable path, frees bench space
phase_1_immediate.risk: None — just a physical move, same ethernet to Flint

phase_2_flint_move.move_Flint: Move Flint FARTHER from current cramped spot
phase_2_flint_move.new_location: Anywhere with ethernet run to ATT modem
phase_2_flint_move.rationale: Flint has WiFi radios — can be anywhere with ethernet backhaul
phase_2_flint_move.benefit: Uncrowds the bench next to Kevin

phase_3_rewire_bench.action: Rewire overcrowded bench — only keep what Kevin touches
phase_3_rewire_bench.rationale: eastGate doesn't need a monitor, sporeGate doesn't either

phase_4_spare_eno1.action: Use eastGate eno1 (10.0.0.1) for direct link to northGate or Flint
phase_4_spare_eno1.benefit: Bypasses MikroTik bottleneck for critical path
phase_4_spare_eno1.need: 1 extra ethernet cable, crossover or direct

northGate_freedom.role: Kevin's driver seat — gaming, Steam, dev, RustDesk hub
northGate_freedom.uses_RustDesk: Remote into any gate from northGate keyboard
northGate_freedom.uses_Amoeba: Cursor → eastGate via SSH/RustDesk for brain work
